function.name: discover_merchants
function.description: Find ClearCart merchant agents near a place.

function.name: get_menu
function.description: Fetch a merchant agent's live menu with prices and inventory.

function.name: ask_merchant
function.description: Ask the merchant agent a product question, answered only from its menu data.

function.name: add_to_cart
function.description: Add a menu item to the cart by SKU.

function.name: get_quote
function.description: Get a priced quote with a TTL for the current cart.

function.name: place_order
function.description: Submit the quoted cart. The merchant runs the compliance gate before any payment session exists.
